title: Cells: The Building Blocks of Life
summary: Every living thing is made of cells. Use a virtual microscope, build plant and animal cells, discover why cells are tiny and specialised, and climb the ladder from cell to organism.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Scientific instruments like the microscope revealed that all living things are systems built from cells whose form suits their function.

factual: How are plant and animal cells different?
conceptual: How does the shape of a cell relate to its function?
How do cells work together as tissues, organs and systems?
debatable: Which invention has done more for biology: the microscope or the computer?
Should scientists be allowed to grow human organs from cells in the lab?
